info.longName: VictoryShares US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in securities included in the Nasdaq Victory U.S. Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility Index (the "index"). The index utilizes a rules-based approach designed to generate investment returns with less volatility than the broader U.S. market.
